data_origin: New synthetic materials created for this package; no user history or benchmark examples.
evaluation_scope: nonfixed-gateway-exploratory; not a fixed-model benchmark or evidence of SIC superiority
output_rule: Final response must be exactly one JSON object, without Markdown fences or explanation. Evidence is a set of file#anchor strings.

cases.objective: Retain task-specific facts across an intervening tool-read and another user turn.

stages.prompt: Synthetic parcel task. Use only the built-in read tool on files under {{MATERIALS}}. Read {{MATERIALS}}/intake.txt now and retain the parcel facts for the next turn. Do not answer the parcel questions yet. Reply exactly {"phase":"ready"}.

Continue the same parcel task. First read {{MATERIALS}}/operations.txt using built-in read. Its unrelated inventory does not replace the earlier intake. Using the original intake, return exactly one JSON object with keys case_id (retention), parcel_id, destination, seal, items (string array), evidence (file#anchor array). Include anchors supporting all parcel facts. No prose.

cases.objective: Revise superseded constraints after a completed provisional turn while retaining an unchanged constraint.

stages.prompt: Synthetic dispatch task. Use built-in read to read {{MATERIALS}}/policy.txt only. Give a provisional JSON plan with keys phase (provisional), destination, courier, handling, evidence (file#anchor array). A later turn may supply a correction; do not invent one now.

A late correction has now arrived. In this same session, use built-in read on {{MATERIALS}}/change.txt. Apply its overrides; retain unchanged constraints from the original policy. Return exactly one JSON object with keys case_id (late-correction), destination, courier, handling, supersedes, evidence (file#anchor array). Cite current overrides and the retained constraint. No prose.

cases.objective: Follow two file links using three actual read results and combine route capacity with manifest weights.

stages.prompt: Synthetic routing task. Start with built-in read on {{MATERIALS}}/index.txt and follow the relevant file links under that same material directory, using read for each file. For request CASE-58, report route_id, batch_id, destination, total_mass_kg, remaining_capacity_kg and can_ship (boolean). Return exactly one JSON object with those keys plus case_id (multi-hop) and evidence (file#anchor array). Cite the index link, route capacity/link and manifest destination/weights. Do not use other files or infer unread contents.
